description: As a user I want the aircraft status badge to use distinct colors so that I can identify status at a glance.

acs.text: The Active status badge displays in green.
The Grounded status badge displays in red.
The In Maintenance status badge displays in the correct color per the design specification.

questions.text: What exact color (hex or Tailwind class) should the In Maintenance badge use?

sections.content: Status badges appear on the aircraft list and aircraft detail views. Badge color must meet WCAG AA contrast standards.
